jobs.name: A_swordsman
jobs.prompt: Cute chibi anime mobile RPG character art, 2.5-heads-tall proportions, big expressive eyes, soft cel shading with gentle gradients, clean thin lineart, bright pastel fantasy colors, polished game key-art quality. A young swordsman hero with messy chestnut-brown hair, a light silver half-helm, a royal blue tunic with pale silver trim, a brown leather belt and boots, holding a straight steel sword, confident friendly smile. Full body, standing in a three-quarter view facing the viewer, centered, isolated on a plain flat light grey background. No text, no logo, no watermark, no frame.

jobs.name: A_onion
